Proposed diagram changes
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: PersistentLayer
  |   |   |-- Reorganize the overview around catalog publication, workspace records, context stores, and persisted agent activity; the former diagram-centric storage overview no longer covers these ownership boundaries.
  |   |   |-- Preserve DiagramPersistence, immutable diagram records, proposal persistence, compatibility paths, and the distinction between autosave and catalog publication.
  |   |   |-- Show MappingDiagramService using WorkspaceRecordStore.capture before publication; expose FileAgentContextRepository, FileDiagramAgentContextStore, FileAgentContextSources, FileChatStore, FileDiffSessionRunStore, and FilePushIntegrationStore with their callers.
  |   |   `-- Keep SearchArtifact explicitly proposed and unimplemented; rendering remains outside storage responsibility.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Checkpoint capture and canvas publication
  |   |   |-- Explain whole-document save: browser checkpoint and persistence flush, manifest-pinned capture, version/head checks, selected checkpoint hydration, publication, then browser acknowledgement.
  |   |   |-- Distinguish node-only save, which still captures and isolates a diagram; failed browser acknowledgement does not undo publication.
  |   |   `-- Develop the existing publication subject; attach from MappingDiagramService.publishCheckpoint and WorkspaceRecordStore.capture in the overview.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Agent activity persistence and recovery
  |       |-- Explain FileChatStore's serialized temporary-file replacement, CanvasHistory's saved-view generation state, DiffSessionWorkflowService's run/artifact writes, and FilePushIntegrationStore's connections and generation claims.
  |       |-- Show workflow context, prompts, requests, responses, conversation, and performance artifacts; a persisted running run without active execution is reported interrupted, not automatically resumed.
  |       |-- Distinguish push create-if-absent publication from subsequent updates; do not imply every store has workspace-style fsync or receipt guarantees.
  |       `-- This is storage detail, not a new agent-execution overview; attach from the explicit activity-store components and link generation state to CanvasHistory.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Replace full-checkpoint/view payload descriptions with checkpoint deltas and shared immutable item references; include document version metadata used by publication capture.
  |   |   |-- Correct server publication to at most eight concurrent writers, waiting for every writer, syncing the blob directory, then atomically publishing manifest and receipt.
  |   |   `-- PATCH fits because the browser-owner -> adapter -> worker -> server -> restore organization remains accurate.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Add CanvasCheckpointEncoder and CanvasValueEncoder under record projection, shared item suppression, semantic equality checks, and reconstruction before workspace validation.
  |   |   |-- Add saveDocument's acknowledged per-document transaction and the explicit checkpoint/flush handoff to catalog publication.
  |   |   `-- Preserve debounce, one in-flight batch, identical uncertain retries, compatibility replacement, and the absence of an abrupt-close flush guarantee.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Checkpoint deltas, shared items, and restore
  |       |-- Explain independently split values, SHA-256-addressed items, shared long text/sourceAscii, and added/updated/removed reference maps.
  |       |-- Show delta depth capped at 31, periodic full reference bases, checkpointHead, legacy snapshot support, and bounded selected-checkpoint replay.
  |       |-- Explain hash/reference validation, immutable dependency reuse, and semantic checkpoint immutability despite re-encoding or transaction-link changes.
  |       `-- Develop the canvas's persistence subject; attach from CanvasCheckpointEncoder, CanvasValueEncoder, and Restore in the updated flow.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   |-- Remove the obsolete DiagramService-as-content-writer relationship; point content issuance and retention to the revised [G] component.
  |   |   `-- Retain workspace/session ownership and the persistence adapter path; those still organize this overview accurately.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   |-- Expose CanvasHistory-owned CanvasViews and checkpointed alternatives, presentation settings, review, and diagram context bindings.
  |   |   `-- Connect persistence detail from WorkspacePersistence and history detail from CanvasHistoryService rather than duplicating storage internals.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   |-- Clarify that append asserts already-issued revisions and retains dependencies; it does not independently issue changed diagram content.
  |   |   `-- Keep checkpoint navigation, exact bindings, provenance, and compatibility materialization; the history-centered organization still fits.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   |-- Add CanvasViews outside restored checkpoint state: saved endpoints, working copies, ancestry, recording, archival, and generation metadata.
  |   |   |-- Add retention of alternative source/base revisions, review revisions, revision selections, and revisionBoundary; named views preserve their complete checkpoint graph during exports.
  |   |   `-- Add encoded persistenceChanges output and link to Checkpoint deltas, shared items, and restore; link saved-view behavior to Saved CanvasViews and branching without redrawing its accurate content.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   |-- Replace the single-service writer model with immutable create/revise/derive operations, explicit runtime revision retention, generation orchestration, and separate persistence/publication adapters.
  |   |   `-- The ownership split requires REDRAW; keep this a compact overview linked to [G] Revision operations, retention, and generation rather than duplicating that diagram's detail.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |       |-- Replace DiagramService create/revise calls with issuance and retention before checkpoint binding; distinguish optional batched exec commits from individual mutation commits.
  |       `-- Preserve the controller validation-and-checkpoint flow; only its obsolete writer and commit-granularity claims need correction.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Update context resolution to AgentContextService.resolve and replace RevisionedDiagramService generation with generation orchestration followed by issuance and retention.
  |   |   `-- Preserve capture, application, and acknowledgement sequencing; distinguish backend-lifetime uploaded contexts from the new durable context library.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Expose AgentContextLibrary and DiagramAgentContextStore as explicit context providers, with FileAgentContextSources supplying retained source evidence.
  |   |   `-- These additions fit the existing context-to-edit flow and establish attachment points for storage detail.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   |-- Add sourceRange blocks, optional portable sourceFiles, and explicit source-resolution adapters alongside immutable snapshots.
  |   |   `-- Preserve validation and context isolation; do not move file or network ownership into the captured domain object.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Durable contexts and portable evidence
  |       |-- Explain saved context identity/request-conflict checks, immutable diagram-context records outside checkpoints, and shared source snapshots or pinned Git references.
  |       |-- Show source persistence and reference validation before context publication, plus workspace import preparation before publishing bindings.
  |       |-- Show portable export expanding current and historical context bindings and including only selected evidence ranges.
  |       `-- Develop the established AgentContext subject; attach from AgentContextLibrary, DiagramAgentContextStore, and FileAgentContextSources, with storage-owner links back to PersistentLayer.
  `-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          |-- Replace whole-document saveNow's live snapshot-to-save path with checkpoint dispatch -> publishCheckpoint -> saved acknowledgement.
          |-- Show WorkspaceRecordStore.capture under publication and MappingWorkspaceService's portableExport/prepareImport responsibilities under workspace persistence.
          `-- PATCH fits the existing grouped responsibilities; link publication and context-storage details from these explicit components rather than duplicating them.
